brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces demolished a residential building in al-Tur Mount in occupied East Jerusalem, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported, forcibly displacing approximately 80 Palestinians, the majority women and children. The demolition follows an ongoing pattern of forced displacement and home demolitions in the territory.

The PCHR condemned the demolition in the strongest terms, characterizing it as part of Israel's systematic policy targeting Palestinian residents in East Jerusalem.

title: Israeli forces demolish East Jerusalem building, displace 80 Palestinians
